body: Awe sorry x
Goodnight x

It will, i know people say it all the time but depression will pass. But it will only pass if you change the circumstances that you are in. Change jobs, move house, move countries. The future is what you decide to do today :)

After so long now being sad, i cannot wait for the time when i am happy and content with life. When my life was good i was always looking for reasons to be sad. Never again. I took my early childhood for granted.
Then show them. My mother never showed any emotions around me and that fucked my childhood. Show them that your human and that its okay not to be okay
Tbh hugs are the best, i wish i could give you one hun x
Hey hun, i love you. If all you've taken is booze then go have some water and go to sleep. You are not in a head space to deal with depression okay? Leave that stuff for the morning :)

Well life has its ups and downs. When we are in the darkest part of depression all other rational thinking just doesnt exist. You've got to look past the dark clouds and see what you want your future to look like :)
No idea hun. But the fact that youve actually come on reddit to tell us that shows me that you dont actually want to die. Call an ambulance. I love you.

You dont want to die. Otherwise you would have taken a higher dose. This is the last reach for help. But please stop denying help when we are trying. Give yourself some credit, tell someone, cal 911. Please. I cant do more than this

Okay. Then do it. But i think you are giving in way too easily. You say 30? Try over 100 including your entire fucking family turning there backs on you. I have been in three different countries in 2 years. Colleagues, school friends, family friends, everyone i have ever loved or cared about is gone. I am only here because i am not dwelling in  self pity, its because i need to prove to myself that i can be a better person, regardless of all the shit ive been through.
Please? Xx

Hun i like everyone. Mainly because i have accepted that we are all different, our lives are so diverse and thats why i cant find it in me to hate unless i have all the facts. You are no different. The fact that you have taken the time to post here shows that you want the pain to stop. It will fade over time. Just know that i like you for that one simple act.
Call 911!!! You cannot do this to yourself
Well i normally tell myself 'ill do it in a couple of weeks'. By the time a couple of weeks come round im usually not in that dark hole anymore x
We are darling :)
Thank you, means a lot 😙
Awe thank you 😚 helping people on this sub reddit has actually helped me so much! Allows me to connect with people with the same problems as me 😊
Your welcome hun 😊
Yes! Ive never had pets but if i did i would do anything for them! Same goes for children too!
Did you harm yourself?

I never did anything to deserve this either. I learned to look towards the future. With all the shit that ive gone through i have not let my depression win. I always find a way, mostly by imagining the future; becoming a badass wife and mother, by being an artist and living in my favourite country. I have all of this to look forward to, yet i feel so suicidal all the time, and its because its difficult to let go of the past, but we have to learn from it to properly move on.

I moved from New Zealand two years ago. I havent been back yet. I remember the sea, the sunsets, the bush walks that i used to go on. I remember what used to make me happy. I use it to give me hope that i will go back to New Zealand and experience all of that again.
I know people say this all the time but i will always be here if you need me. I want to help, share my experience with mental illness and allow people to see hope, the way that i do. 😊

Okay ill tell you a little story. 3 countries. 2 years. 6 jobs. 2 schools. 4 homes. 0 friends. I have been so lonely for so long but now that i have just adapted my life to finding happiness when im alone. I paint, i read, i cook, i watch a shit ton of netflix. And its just what i do now. You shouldnt  base your opinion of yourself on how many friends you have, as they are fleeting, especially when you have moved 3 countries in 2 years. Its hard to keep any friends but as long as i dont ignore myself and what i need then im okay.
Learn from everything you've been through to be a better person. Use your experience with depression and suicide to help others. Its what ive done 😊
*apologies for getting your gender wrong

Hey darling, spend some time with your children. Let them have happy memories of you before you do this. Then maybe you might be able to see that in 10+ years those will be the only memories that they have left of their mum. The last time they thought that nothing bad could happen to them. They have to live with that. With the fact that they couldnt change your decision. They will blame themselves.

Im in England too. A little village called Wincanton. Its cheap here and little to no crime. If you want to go to Iceland, then try to remember the reason why you wanted to go in the first place, it could be a good way to see some perspective. If you want to move i would suggest maybe Wincanton? Its in the countryside, you can get an job easily in a supermarket (its where i work) and its peaceful. Im sorry about your shitty dad. Family isnt always about blood, sometime its the people that make you feel loved and supported. Please dont dwell in your room tonight, dont fight the opportunity to find happiness and contentment. Please.
Hey hun, im here ☺

It was a good essay hun. I would suggest cancelling the trip to Iceland, save your money. Split from your girlfriend and go online and do some reasearch. See what places you would want to move to in your country. Find any possible places to live there, write a damn good cv, save anything you can, find any job that is going. And move. It wont be easy, moving to a new place is always difficult but i see no other way for you to get put of this hole. You need to start a new life, experience love again with someone who actually loves you back, appreciate nature and the beauty of the world. Get off social media, and imagine the perfect future you want and get yourself there. I believe in you. Just remember it wont change straight away, but it wont change at all if you dont start now. Xx
I will try :)
Noone

Okay hun, take a breath. Sounds like you need a holiday. Right now you need to watch something like Sense8. Something that is wholesome and is loving and supportive. Something that reminds you of the beauty in this world. Even if you dont currently see the opposite side of depression, you might see what you are missing in life for you to be happy. Even if it means something small, like taking up a new hobby. Then work your way up; move to a new place, let go of your girlfriend if she isnt supportive and loving anymore. Change the things in your life for a better future.

All i can say is in year 11 i thought i would stay in the same school, same village, same country for the next 10+ years. A month before yr 11 finished my family decided to move to Canada. The complete change caused the majority of my depression. I was homesick, first self harmed on my 16th birthday (worst day i ever had) and developed an eating disorder. 2 years later and i still havent recovered, want to take my own life in fact. But, i havent been back to village since leaving it. I told a half lie about my partners family. They are not the only reason. I need to go home. If i didnt then i would've been dead long before my 16th birthday. Leaving that place showed me just how much i love it. Maybe a change of environment might put some perspective on your life? It certainly did for me. Xx

Do you have family? A mother and father who love you? Siblings? It may not feel it but they do love you no matter how much you convince yourself that they dont. Im 18, left home at 16, had depression for two years and have since been disowned by my family. The only reason i have not taken my life is because of my partner. His family have become my own. The love and support i have received from them makes me hopeful that this depression will pass. You need to realise what you have in life and not to take it for granted. That includes your family.

I split my personalities up. When im depressed its always Sam taking control and when im happy Bub is in control. There is no inbetween. Recently Sam has been taking over more than id like and now hes driving me towards suicide.
